reviewers.summary: The change adds coverage for the listed authenticated quota outcomes and reset-body cases, but two explicit acceptance checks are not asserted: the stale_revision error code and zero quota consumption for unauthenticated requests.

findingList.message: The AC-030 test does not assert error.code is exactly stale_revision for the stale revision case.

evidence.codePathTraced: AC030_ResetBodyAcceptsAndRejectsExactContractCases sends a stale revision and asserts only the HTTP status.
evidence.failureScenario: If the endpoint returns HTTP 409 with an error code other than stale_revision, this test still passes, despite AC-030 requiring the exact code.

findingList.message: The AC-030/M-13 test does not verify that an unauthenticated reset attempt consumes no quota unit.

evidence.codePathTraced: AC030_ResetEndpointCountsEveryAuthenticatedAttempt sends authenticated attempts only and checks quota counts for those users.
evidence.failureScenario: If an unauthenticated reset request consumes a quota unit, the test still passes because it never sends an unauthenticated request or checks the quota afterward.

reviewers.summary: The tests cover the main reset validation, quota, and store-failure paths. They leave explicit acceptance details unverified: unauthenticated quota behavior, the named time and reason extra properties, and the stale_revision error code.

findingList.message: The quota test does not verify the criterion that unauthenticated requests consume no quota unit.

evidence.codePathTraced: AC030_ResetEndpointCountsEveryAuthenticatedAttempt sends accepted, replayed, malformed, rate-limited, and denied-role requests, but sends no unauthenticated request.
evidence.failureScenario: If an unauthenticated reset attempt consumes quota, this test still passes; the criterion requires that it consume no unit.

findingList.message: The request contract test omits the explicitly listed time and reason extra-property cases.

evidence.codePathTraced: AC030_ResetBodyAcceptsAndRejectsExactContractCases tests an extra actor property, but not the explicitly named time or reason properties.
evidence.failureScenario: If the endpoint later accepts time or reason while still rejecting actor, the named contract test passes despite those inputs being required to return validation_error.

findingList.message: The stale-revision case does not assert the required error code stale_revision.

evidence.codePathTraced: The stale-command assertion checks only the HTTP status code.
evidence.failureScenario: If a stale revision returns HTTP 409 with an error code other than stale_revision, the test still passes.

reviewers.summary: The changed endpoint appears to enforce the listed input shapes and return a generic 500 on reset failures. The named tests leave required quota, extra-property, and stale-revision error-code cases unverified.

findingList.message: The named test does not verify AC-030 / M-13's requirement that unauthenticated requests consume no quota unit.

evidence.codePathTraced: AC-030 / M-13 names CasePackEndpointsTests.AC030_ResetEndpointCountsEveryAuthenticatedAttempt as its verification.
evidence.failureScenario: If an unauthenticated reset request consumes quota, this test still passes because it never sends an unauthenticated request or checks the quota afterward.

findingList.message: The named contract test checks only an extra actor property; it does not verify the explicitly listed time and reason properties.

evidence.codePathTraced: AC-030 / M-06 requires rejecting extra actor, time, reason, and any other unlisted property, and requires the test to verify every table row.
evidence.failureScenario: If the parser accepts an unlisted time or reason property while still rejecting actor, the single extra-actor case passes and the test does not detect the contract violation.

findingList.message: The stale-revision case does not assert the required error.code value stale_revision.

evidence.codePathTraced: AC-030 / M-06 requires a stale nonnegative revision on a new command to return 409 stale_revision.
evidence.failureScenario: If the stale-revision response uses a different error code, the test still passes because it asserts only the HTTP status.
